result:
551 unit tests pass, none broke.

**Findings + fix:**

1. `dropped_critical` — never populated. Code set it to `[]` before check, then inside `if not budget_met` re-set to `[]` again (no-op, wrong direction of intent). Fix: populate with IDs of critical (protected) items still in output when budget not met (`src/verityai/context/prune.py:108`).

2. Tiebreak sort — key used `-i.original_index` ascending, which puts **newest** first among tied scores (since `-3 < -2 < -1 < 0` for indices 3,2,1,0), so newest got dropped first. Docstring/comment say oldest dropped first. Fix: drop the negation, sort by `i.original_index` ascending (`prune.py:285`).

Added 3 regression tests in `tests/unit/test_prune.py`: dropped_critical populated on budget miss, stays empty on budget met, tiebreak drops oldest first. `pytest tests/unit/test_prune.py -q` → 24 passed. Full `tests/unit` → 551 passed. (Integration tests fail to collect — missing `typer` module, unrelated to this change.)
